buildMachinery.fact: The Android release graph runs frozen Bun installs in exactly the repository root, packages/bun-error, and src/node-fallbacks.
The Android release graph invokes the Cargo workspace build for bun_bin.

cargo.note: Cargo.lock supplies a SHA-256 for every crates.io package and contains no Git source. All 181 canonical .crate files are project-locked by URL, byte count, and SHA-256; the materializer can reproduce their versioned directory source, and pinned Cargo accepted the full Bun workspace with --locked --offline and an empty CARGO_HOME.

bunInstall.note: The Linux x64 selection resolves 172 external references to 125 unique archives after deduplication and 39 platform exclusions. All canonical npm tarballs are locked by Bun SHA-512, project SHA-256, and exact byte count; a minimal 125-directory cache with exact executable modes was reproduced on WSL2 ext4 and passed all three frozen installs with the cache read-only in the locked Ubuntu container under --network none.

excludedDownloaders: Windows xwin and NuGet sysroot inputs
targetExclusions.reason: The local android-release profile builds C++ and Rust in one Linux x86_64 process and targets only Android; these host/target-specific branches are inactive.

readiness.resolutionGate: Lock the mutable Ubuntu/PPA/apt.llvm.org host package layer, then run configure and Ninja with network disabled and prove that no unrecorded fetch occurs.
